<style>
    :root {
      --green-900: #0F3D2E;
      --green-800: #1F4A36;
      --green-700: #2F6B4F;
      --green-500: #6B8E7F;
      --green-300: #A8C4B5;
      --amber-500: #E8A341;
      --amber-300: #F2C575;
      --cream-50: #FAF7F0;
      --cream-100: #F0E9D8;
      --cream-200: #E5DCC4;
      --ink-900: #1A1F1B;
      --ink-700: #3D4540;
      --ink-500: #8B8579;
      --alert-amber: #C97539;
      --success-green: #5A9B6E;
      --font-display: 'Fraunces', Georgia, serif;
      --font-body: 'Inter', -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif;
      --font-mono: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace;
      --max: 1280px;
    }

    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }

    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }

    body {
      margin: 0;
      font-family: var(--font-body);
      font-size: 16px;
      line-height: 1.6;
      color: var(--ink-900);
      background: var(--cream-50);
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
      -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
      overflow-x: hidden;
    }

    h1, h2, h3, h4 {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-weight: 500;
      line-height: 1.05;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--ink-900);
    }

    p { margin: 0; }
    a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
    img, video { max-width: 100%; display: block; }

    .container {
      max-width: var(--max);
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 0 clamp(1.25rem, 5vw, 3rem);
    }

    .eyebrow {
      font-family: var(--font-body);
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.18em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--green-700);
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.6rem;
    }
    .eyebrow::before {
      content: "";
      width: 24px;
      height: 1px;
      background: var(--amber-500);
    }

    .section {
      padding: clamp(4.5rem, 10vh, 8rem) 0;
    }

    .section--green { background: var(--green-900); color: var(--cream-50); }
    .section--green h1, .section--green h2, .section--green h3 { color: var(--cream-50); }
    .section--green .eyebrow { color: var(--amber-300); }
    .section--green .eyebrow::before { background: var(--amber-500); }

    .section--cream { background: var(--cream-100); }

    /* ===== NAV ===== */
    .nav {
      position: fixed;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      z-index: 100;
      padding: 1.25rem 0;
      transition: background 300ms ease, box-shadow 300ms ease, padding 300ms ease;
    }
    .nav--scrolled {
      background: rgba(250, 247, 240, 0.92);
      backdrop-filter: saturate(180%) blur(16px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: saturate(180%) blur(16px);
      box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(31, 74, 54, 0.08);
      padding: 0.75rem 0;
    }
    .nav__inner {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 2rem;
    }
    .nav__logo {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.65rem;
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 1.35rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
      color: var(--cream-50);
      transition: color 300ms ease;
    }
    .nav--scrolled .nav__logo { color: var(--green-900); }
    .nav__logo img {
      width: 32px;
      height: 32px;
      transition: filter 300ms ease;
    }
    .nav__links {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 1.75rem;
    }
    .nav__link {
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--cream-50);
      opacity: 0.85;
      transition: opacity 200ms ease, color 300ms ease;
    }
    .nav--scrolled .nav__link { color: var(--ink-700); }
    .nav__link:hover { opacity: 1; }
    .nav__cta {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.4rem;
      padding: 0.6rem 1.15rem;
      background: var(--cream-50);
      color: var(--green-900);
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      border-radius: 999px;
      transition: transform 200ms ease, background 200ms ease;
    }
    .nav--scrolled .nav__cta {
      background: var(--green-900);
      color: var(--cream-50);
    }
    .nav__cta:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); }

    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .nav__links .nav__link:not(.nav__link--provider) { display: none; }
    }

    /* ===== HERO ===== */
    .hero {
      position: relative;
      min-height: 100vh;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: var(--green-900);
    }
    .hero__video {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
      opacity: 0.42;
    }
    .hero__overlay {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background:
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(15, 61, 46, 0.55) 0%, rgba(15, 61, 46, 0.7) 50%, rgba(15, 61, 46, 0.95) 100%),
        radial-gradient(ellipse at 30% 50%, rgba(15, 61, 46, 0.0) 0%, rgba(15, 61, 46, 0.6) 100%);
    }
    .hero__content {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 2;
      padding-top: 8rem;
      padding-bottom: 5rem;
      max-width: 1000px;
    }
    .hero__eyebrow {
      color: var(--amber-300);
      margin-bottom: 2rem;
    }
    .hero__eyebrow::before { background: var(--amber-500); }
    .hero__title {
      font-size: clamp(2.75rem, 8.5vw, 7.25rem);
      line-height: 0.98;
      letter-spacing: -0.035em;
      color: var(--cream-50);
      margin-bottom: 1.75rem;
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(20px);
      animation: fadeUp 0.9s 0.1s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) forwards;
    }
    .hero__title em {
      font-style: italic;
      font-weight: 400;
      color: var(--amber-300);
    }
    .hero__sub {
      font-size: clamp(1.05rem, 1.6vw, 1.25rem);
      line-height: 1.55;
      max-width: 580px;
      color: var(--cream-100);
      margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(20px);
      animation: fadeUp 0.8s 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) forwards;
    }
    .hero__ctas {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 0.85rem;
      margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(20px);
      animation: fadeUp 0.8s 0.7s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) forwards;
    }
    .hero__trial {
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      color: var(--cream-100);
      opacity: 0.7;
      opacity: 0;
      animation: fadeUp 0.8s 0.9s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) forwards;
    }

    .btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.65rem;
      padding: 0.95rem 1.5rem;
      border-radius: 999px;
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      transition: transform 200ms ease, box-shadow 200ms ease, background 200ms ease;
      border: 1px solid transparent;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-family: inherit;
      text-decoration: none;
    }
    .btn--primary {
      background: var(--cream-50);
      color: var(--green-900);
    }
    .btn--primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.2); }
    .btn--ghost {
      background: transparent;
      color: var(--cream-50);
      border-color: rgba(250, 247, 240, 0.3);
    }
    .btn--ghost:hover { background: rgba(250, 247, 240, 0.08); transform: translateY(-2px); }
    .btn--dark {
      background: var(--green-900);
      color: var(--cream-50);
    }
    .btn--dark:hover { background: var(--green-800); transform: translateY(-2px); }
    .btn--cream {
      background: var(--cream-50);
      color: var(--green-900);
      border: 1px solid var(--cream-200);
    }
    .btn--cream:hover { background: var(--cream-100); transform: translateY(-2px); }
    .btn__sub { display: flex; flex-direction: column; line-height: 1.1; }
    .btn__sub small { font-size: 0.65rem; font-weight: 400; opacity: 0.7; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; }
    .btn__sub strong { font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; }
    .btn svg { flex-shrink: 0; }

    @keyframes fadeUp {
      to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
    }

    /* ===== TRUST STRIP ===== */
    .trust {
      background: var(--green-800);
      color: var(--cream-50);
      padding: 1.5rem 0;
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(250, 247, 240, 0.08);
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(250, 247, 240, 0.08);
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .trust__inner {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 0.5rem 2.5rem;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      color: var(--cream-100);
    }
    .trust__item {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.6rem;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .trust__item::before {
      content: "";
      width: 6px;
      height: 6px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--amber-500);
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .trust__item:nth-child(n+4) { display: none; }
    }

    /* ===== DIFFERENTIATOR ===== */
    .diff__head { max-width: 720px; margin-bottom: 4rem; }
    .diff__head h2 {
      font-size: clamp(2rem, 4.5vw, 3.5rem);
      margin-top: 1.25rem;
      margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    }
    .diff__head p {
      font-size: 1.125rem;
      color: var(--ink-700);
      max-width: 560px;
    }
    .diff__grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 1.5rem;
    }
    @media (max-width: 900px) { .diff__grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
    .diff__card {
      background: var(--cream-100);
      border: 1px solid var(--cream-200);
      border-radius: 20px;
      padding: 2.25rem 2rem;
      transition: transform 300ms ease, box-shadow 300ms ease;
    }
    .diff__card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 20px 40px -20px rgba(31, 74, 54, 0.15); }
    .diff__num {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--amber-500);
      margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
      letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    }
    .diff__card h3 {
      font-size: 1.5rem;
      margin-bottom: 0.85rem;
    }
    .diff__card p {
      color: var(--ink-700);
      font-size: 0.975rem;
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    /* ===== LAB DEMO ===== */
    .lab {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1.05fr 1fr;
      gap: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 4.5rem);
      align-items: center;
    }
    @media (max-width: 900px) { .lab { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
    .lab__img {
      border-radius: 20px;
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: 0 30px 60px -30px rgba(31, 74, 54, 0.4);
    }
    .lab__img img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; }
    .lab__copy h2 {
      font-size: clamp(1.85rem, 3.8vw, 2.85rem);
      margin-top: 1.25rem;
      margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    }
    .lab__copy > p {
      font-size: 1.0625rem;
      color: var(--ink-700);
      margin-bottom: 2.25rem;
    }
    .lab__markers {
      background: var(--cream-50);
      border: 1px solid var(--cream-200);
      border-radius: 16px;
      padding: 1.5rem;
    }
    .lab__markers-head {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.65rem;
      margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--green-700);
    }
    .lab__markers-head::before {
      content: "";
      width: 10px;
      height: 10px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--alert-amber);
    }
    .lab__row {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 0.85rem 0;
      border-top: 1px dashed var(--cream-200);
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 0.9rem;
    }
    .lab__row:first-of-type { border-top: none; }
    .lab__row-name { color: var(--ink-900); }
    .lab__row-val { color: var(--alert-amber); font-weight: 600; }
    .lab__row-tag {
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      padding: 0.2rem 0.5rem;
      border-radius: 4px;
      background: rgba(201, 117, 57, 0.12);
      color: var(--alert-amber);
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    /* ===== STEPS ===== */
    .steps__head { text-align: center; margin-bottom: 4rem; }
    .steps__head .eyebrow { justify-content: center; }
    .steps__head h2 {
      font-size: clamp(1.85rem, 3.8vw, 2.85rem);
      margin-top: 1.25rem;
    }
    .steps__grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 2rem;
      position: relative;
    }
    @media (max-width: 900px) { .steps__grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
    .step {
      position: relative;
      padding: 2.25rem 1.75rem;
      background: var(--cream-100);
      border-radius: 20px;
      border: 1px solid var(--cream-200);
    }
    .step__num {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 3rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--amber-500);
      line-height: 1;
      margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    }
    .step h3 {
      font-size: 1.5rem;
      margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
    }
    .step p {
      color: var(--ink-700);
      font-size: 0.975rem;
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    /* ===== VITALITY ===== */
    .vitality {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 5rem);
      align-items: center;
    }
    @media (max-width: 900px) { .vitality { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
    .vitality__copy h2 {
      font-size: clamp(2rem, 4.5vw, 3.5rem);
      margin-top: 1.25rem;
      margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    }
    .vitality__copy > p {
      font-size: 1.0625rem;
      color: rgba(250, 247, 240, 0.8);
      margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
    }
    .vitality__stats {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 1.5rem;
      margin-top: 2.5rem;
    }
    .vitality__stat {
      padding: 1.25rem 0;
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(250, 247, 240, 0.15);
    }
    .vitality__stat strong {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 2.25rem;
      color: var(--amber-300);
      display: flex;
      align-items: baseline;
      gap: 0.2rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
      line-height: 1.1;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .vitality__stat span {
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      color: rgba(250, 247, 240, 0.7);
      display: block;
      margin-top: 0.25rem;
    }
    .vitality__visual {
      position: relative;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
    }
    .vitality__phone {
      max-width: 380px;
      width: 100%;
      border-radius: 36px;
      filter: drop-shadow(0 30px 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4));
    }
    .vitality__float {
      position: absolute;
      background: var(--cream-50);
      color: var(--green-900);
      padding: 0.85rem 1.1rem;
      border-radius: 14px;
      box-shadow: 0 20px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.5rem;
    }
    .vitality__float--1 { top: 12%; left: -8%; animation: float 6s ease-in-out infinite; }
    .vitality__float--2 { bottom: 18%; right: -4%; animation: float 6s 1s ease-in-out infinite; }
    .vitality__float--1::before, .vitality__float--2::before {
      content: "";
      width: 8px;
      height: 8px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--success-green);
    }
    @keyframes float {
      0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); }
      50% { transform: translateY(-8px); }
    }
    @media (max-width: 900px) {
      .vitality__float--1 { left: 0; }
      .vitality__float--2 { right: 0; }
    }

    /* ===== INDIA ===== */
    .india {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.1fr;
      gap: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 5rem);
      align-items: center;
    }
    @media (max-width: 900px) { .india { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
    .india__img {
      position: relative;
      border-radius: 24px;
      overflow: hidden;
      aspect-ratio: 1;
      box-shadow: 0 30px 60px -30px rgba(31, 74, 54, 0.4);
    }
    .india__img img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; }
    .india__copy h2 {
      font-size: clamp(1.85rem, 4vw, 3.25rem);
      margin-top: 1.25rem;
      margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    }
    .india__copy > p {
      font-size: 1.0625rem;
      color: var(--ink-700);
      margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    }
    .india__list {
      list-style: none;
      padding: 0;
      margin: 0;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 0.5rem 1.5rem;
    }
    .india__list li {
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      color: var(--ink-700);
      padding-left: 1.5rem;
      position: relative;
    }
    .india__list li::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      left: 0;
      top: 0.5rem;
      width: 8px;
      height: 8px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--amber-500);
    }

    /* ===== CONDITIONS ===== */
    .cond__head { text-align: center; margin-bottom: 3rem; }
    .cond__head .eyebrow { justify-content: center; }
    .cond__head h2 {
      font-size: clamp(1.85rem, 4vw, 3rem);
      margin-top: 1.25rem;
      margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
    }
    .cond__head p {
      font-size: 1.0625rem;
      color: var(--ink-700);
      max-width: 580px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }
    .cond__cloud {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 0.6rem;
      justify-content: center;
      max-width: 980px;
      margin: 0 auto 3rem;
    }
    .cond__pill {
      padding: 0.6rem 1.2rem;
      background: var(--cream-100);
      border: 1px solid var(--cream-200);
      border-radius: 999px;
      font-size: 0.925rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--ink-900);
      transition: background 200ms ease, transform 200ms ease;
    }
    .cond__pill:hover { background: var(--green-800); color: var(--cream-50); transform: translateY(-2px); }
    .cond__pill--accent {
      background: var(--green-900);
      color: var(--cream-50);
      border-color: var(--green-900);
    }
    .cond__ctas { display: flex; gap: 0.85rem; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }

    /* ===== PRIVACY ===== */
    .priv__head { text-align: center; margin-bottom: 3.5rem; }
    .priv__head .eyebrow { justify-content: center; }
    .priv__head h2 {
      font-size: clamp(1.85rem, 4vw, 3rem);
      margin-top: 1.25rem;
    }
    .priv__grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 1.5rem;
    }
    @media (max-width: 900px) { .priv__grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
    .priv__card {
      background: var(--cream-50);
      border: 1px solid var(--cream-200);
      border-radius: 18px;
      padding: 2rem;
    }
    .priv__icon {
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      background: var(--green-900);
      color: var(--amber-300);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
    }
    .priv__card h3 { font-size: 1.25rem; margin-bottom: 0.6rem; }
    .priv__card p { font-size: 0.95rem; color: var(--ink-700); line-height: 1.6; }

    /* ===== PRICING ===== */
    .price__head { text-align: center; margin-bottom: 3.5rem; }
    .price__head .eyebrow { justify-content: center; }
    .price__head h2 {
      font-size: clamp(1.85rem, 4vw, 3rem);
      margin-top: 1.25rem;
      margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
    }
    .price__head p {
      font-size: 1.0625rem;
      color: var(--ink-700);
    }
    .price__grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      gap: 1.5rem;
      max-width: 800px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }
    @media (max-width: 700px) { .price__grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
    .price__card {
      background: var(--cream-100);
      border: 1px solid var(--cream-200);
      border-radius: 22px;
      padding: 2.5rem 2rem;
      position: relative;
    }
    .price__card--featured {
      background: var(--green-900);
      color: var(--cream-50);
      border-color: var(--green-900);
    }
    .price__card--featured h3, .price__card--featured strong { color: var(--cream-50); }
    .price__badge {
      position: absolute;
      top: -12px;
      right: 24px;
      background: var(--amber-500);
      color: var(--green-900);
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 0.35rem 0.75rem;
      border-radius: 999px;
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }
    .price__card h3 {
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.1em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--ink-700);
      margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    }
    .price__amount {
      display: flex;
      align-items: baseline;
      gap: 0.4rem;
      margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    }
    .price__amount strong {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 3.25rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
      line-height: 1;
    }
    .price__amount span { font-size: 0.95rem; opacity: 0.7; }
    .price__desc {
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      opacity: 0.7;
      margin-bottom: 1.75rem;
    }
    .price__list {
      list-style: none;
      padding: 0;
      margin: 0 0 2rem;
    }
    .price__list li {
      padding: 0.5rem 0 0.5rem 1.6rem;
      font-size: 0.925rem;
      position: relative;
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(31, 74, 54, 0.1);
    }
    .price__card--featured .price__list li { border-color: rgba(250, 247, 240, 0.12); }
    .price__list li::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      left: 0;
      top: 1rem;
      width: 14px;
      height: 14px;
      background: var(--amber-500);
      -webkit-mask: url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 24 24'><path d='M9 16.17 4.83 12l-1.42 1.41L9 19 21 7l-1.41-1.41z'/></svg>") no-repeat center;
      mask: url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 24 24'><path d='M9 16.17 4.83 12l-1.42 1.41L9 19 21 7l-1.41-1.41z'/></svg>") no-repeat center;
    }
    .price__list li:first-child { border-top: none; }

    /* ===== FAQ ===== */
    .faq__head { text-align: center; margin-bottom: 3.5rem; }
    .faq__head .eyebrow { justify-content: center; }
    .faq__head h2 {
      font-size: clamp(1.85rem, 4vw, 3rem);
      margin-top: 1.25rem;
    }
    .faq__list {
      max-width: 820px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }
    .faq__item {
      background: var(--cream-50);
      border: 1px solid var(--cream-200);
      border-radius: 14px;
      margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: border-color 200ms ease;
    }
    .faq__item[open] { border-color: var(--green-700); }
    .faq__item summary {
      list-style: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      padding: 1.5rem 1.75rem;
      font-size: 1.05rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--ink-900);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 1rem;
    }
    .faq__item summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
    .faq__item summary::after {
      content: "+";
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 1.5rem;
      font-weight: 400;
      color: var(--green-700);
      transition: transform 200ms ease;
    }
    .faq__item[open] summary::after { content: "−"; }
    .faq__item p {
      padding: 0 1.75rem 1.5rem;
      color: var(--ink-700);
      font-size: 0.975rem;
      line-height: 1.65;
    }

    /* ===== FINAL CTA ===== */
    .final {
      background: var(--green-900);
      color: var(--cream-50);
      text-align: center;
      padding: clamp(5rem, 12vh, 9rem) 0;
    }
    .final h2 {
      font-size: clamp(2rem, 5.5vw, 4.25rem);
      max-width: 900px;
      margin: 0 auto 1.5rem;
      color: var(--cream-50);
    }
    .final h2 em { color: var(--amber-300); font-style: italic; }
    .final p {
      font-size: 1.125rem;
      color: var(--cream-100);
      opacity: 0.85;
      max-width: 540px;
      margin: 0 auto 2.5rem;
    }
    .final__ctas {
      display: flex;
      gap: 0.85rem;
      justify-content: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    }
    .final__note {
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      color: var(--cream-100);
      opacity: 0.6;
    }

    /* ===== FOOTER ===== */
    .footer {
      background: var(--green-900);
      color: var(--cream-100);
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(250, 247, 240, 0.08);
      padding: 4rem 0 2rem;
    }
    .footer__top {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1.5fr 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 2.5rem;
      padding-bottom: 3rem;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(250, 247, 240, 0.08);
    }
    @media (max-width: 900px) {
      .footer__top { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
    }
    @media (max-width: 600px) {
      .footer__top { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    }
    .footer__brand { max-width: 320px; }
    .footer__logo {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.65rem;
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 1.35rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--cream-50);
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
    }
    .footer__logo img { width: 32px; height: 32px; }
    .footer__tag {
      font-size: 0.925rem;
      color: var(--cream-100);
      opacity: 0.7;
      line-height: 1.55;
    }
    .footer__col h4 {
      font-family: var(--font-body);
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.12em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--amber-300);
      margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
    }
    .footer__col ul { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; }
    .footer__col li { margin-bottom: 0.65rem; }
    .footer__col a {
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      color: var(--cream-100);
      opacity: 0.7;
      transition: opacity 200ms ease, color 200ms ease;
    }
    .footer__col a:hover { opacity: 1; color: var(--cream-50); }
    .footer__bottom {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding-top: 2rem;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 1rem;
      font-size: 0.825rem;
      color: var(--cream-100);
      opacity: 0.6;
    }
    .footer__bottom a:hover { opacity: 1; }

    /* ===== SCROLL REVEAL ===== */
    /* Content is visible by default. The hero has its own CSS-only
       fade-up animation. Sections are otherwise static for reliability. */
    .reveal {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: none;
    }
  
.blog-shell{padding:9rem 0 6rem;background:var(--cream-50);min-height:70vh}.blog-wrap{max-width:900px;margin:0 auto}.blog-kicker{color:var(--green-700);font-size:.75rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase}.blog-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--cream-200);border-radius:18px;padding:clamp(1.5rem,4vw,4rem);box-shadow:0 12px 34px rgba(31,74,54,.08)}.blog-card h1,.blog-card h2{font-family:var(--font-display);color:var(--ink-900);line-height:1.08}.blog-card h1{font-size:clamp(2.35rem,6vw,4.5rem);margin:1rem 0}.blog-card h2{font-size:clamp(1.8rem,4vw,2.6rem);margin:2rem 0 1rem}.blog-card p,.blog-card li{color:var(--ink-700)}.blog-card article>img,.blog-card article figure img{width:100%;border-radius:14px;margin:1.5rem 0}.blog-card article a{color:var(--green-700);font-weight:600}.blog-card article table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;margin:1.5rem 0;display:block;overflow-x:auto}.blog-card article th,.blog-card article td{border:1px solid var(--cream-200);padding:.7rem;text-align:left}.blog-back{display:inline-flex;margin-bottom:1.25rem;color:var(--green-700);font-weight:600}.blog-index-list{display:grid;gap:1rem;margin-top:2rem}.blog-index-item{padding:1.25rem 0;border-top:1px solid var(--cream-200)}.blog-index-item h2{margin:.35rem 0;font-size:1.65rem}.blog-index-item p{margin:.5rem 0 1rem}.blog-date{font-size:.8rem;color:var(--ink-500)}@media(max-width:768px){.blog-shell{padding-top:7.5rem}.blog-card{border-radius:14px;padding:1.25rem}}

/* Editorial rhythm for article sections, FAQ, and conclusion */
.blog-card article{max-width:760px;margin:0 auto}.blog-card article h1{margin:0 0 1.75rem}.blog-card article h2{margin:3.25rem 0 1rem}.blog-card article p{margin:0 0 1.25rem}.blog-card article ul,.blog-card article ol{margin:0 0 1.75rem;padding-left:1.5rem}.blog-card article li{margin:.45rem 0}.blog-card article #key-takeaway{margin:2rem 0 2.75rem;padding:1.25rem 1.5rem;border-left:3px solid var(--amber-500);background:var(--cream-100);border-radius:0 12px 12px 0}.blog-card article #key-takeaway p{margin:0;color:var(--green-900);font-weight:500}.blog-card article figure{margin:2.75rem 0 0}.blog-card article figure img{margin:0}.blog-card article figure figcaption{margin-top:.7rem;color:var(--ink-500);font-size:.85rem;text-align:center}.blog-card article #faq{margin-top:3.5rem;padding-top:2.5rem;border-top:1px solid var(--cream-200)}.blog-card article #faq h2{margin:0 0 1rem}.blog-card article #faq details{border-bottom:1px solid var(--cream-200)}.blog-card article #faq summary{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:1rem;padding:1.1rem 0;cursor:pointer;color:var(--green-900);font-weight:600;list-style:none}.blog-card article #faq summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.blog-card article #faq summary::after{content:'+';color:var(--amber-500);font-size:1.35rem;font-weight:400}.blog-card article #faq details[open] summary::after{content:'−'}.blog-card article #faq details p{padding:0 2rem 1.15rem 0;margin:0;color:var(--ink-700)}.blog-card article #faq + h2{margin-top:3.5rem}.blog-card article #faq + p{margin-top:3.5rem;padding-top:2rem;border-top:1px solid var(--cream-200)}
</style>
